node_id: cBioPortal SLC7A11 methylation ILC vs IDC TCGA brca_tcga entrez 23533 probes cg21877274 cg24869834
finding: No published literature directly compares SLC7A11 methylation between ILC and IDC in TCGA. However, SLC7A11 (xCT transporter) is established as a critical ferroptosis suppressor: downregulated in drug-resistant cancers (PMID 41879909 colorectal, PMID 41782241 cervical) and co-regulated with GPX4 and NRF2 antioxidant networks. The mechanism is conserved across cancer types. This gap—no methylation profiling of SLC7A11 in ILC specifically—represents a testable hypothesis: differential methylation at probes cg21877274 and cg24869834 could correlate with ILC-specific ferroptosis resistance and immune infiltration patterns (xCT controls cystine/glutamate exchange relevant to T-cell metabolism).

evidence_items.excerpt: FOSL1 was significantly overexpressed in oxaliplatin-resistant CRC cells and was negatively correlated with ferroptosis-related proteins GPX4, SLC7A11, and FTH1. Silencing FOSL1 reduced resistance by promoting ferroptosis.
evidence_items.relevance: Establishes SLC7A11 downregulation in chemotherapy resistance

evidence_items.excerpt: ANO6 overexpression correlated with worse prognosis; ANO6 depletion reduced GPX4, SLC7A11, and NRF2, increased ferroptosis sensitivity. SLC7A11 is part of ferroptosis suppression axis in drug resistance.
evidence_items.relevance: Confirms SLC7A11 as universal ferroptosis suppressor across cancer types (cervical model)
